text_block_list.text:
I happen to spot Нарита Таисин and am
about to
call out to her when she stops
me with a deadly
glare.
Halt! Don't you dare come any closer!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I can't deal with noisy dimwits like you
or Ticket
right now.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
My head'll split apart if you screech at
me like
you always do!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
One step closer... and I'll seriously punt
you into
space.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Should we cancel training today, then?

text_block_list.text: As if! I'll be fine once I rest for a bi—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: I really think you should rest.

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, fine! I'll go to the infirmary! You
happy
now?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
She looks at me with the desperation of
a
wounded beast as she stalks off.
